definitions.explanation: Putting food on a skewer; or something or someone run through with a pointed object.

examples.english: We grilled skewered fish over the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{祭|まつ}り→お祭り：01349_omatsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{屋台|やたい}→屋台：10549_yatai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{串刺|くしざ}しにした⟦{鮎|あゆ}→鮎：31757_ayu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{売|う}られていた→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: At the festival stalls, salt-grilled sweetfish on skewers were on sale.
